catalog.description: a border hold cascading into the downstream legs; the forecast breaches the promised window
a sort hub backs up (missort/backlog); slack tightens
leg traffic delaying the current leg
the carrier ETA under-reports the delay; the forecast reads healthier than the accumulated leg delay
position and heartbeat stopped mid-leg; the shipment cannot currently be seen
a mid-journey delay fully absorbed downstream; the shipment will still make the window

objective: Forecast whether this shipment will miss its promised delivery window by reasoning over the WHOLE remaining route, not the loudest single leg. A large leg delay that the remaining route can absorb (slack still positive) is NOT a breach. Name the link driving any slip: customs hold, hub backlog, or leg traffic. Cross-check the carrier ETA (slack) against the accumulated leg delay - if the ETA looks optimistic relative to the delay, do not trust it. Prefer a watch plus a proactive customer heads-up at moderate risk; reserve the costly reroute or expedite for a confirmed forecast breach. Never re-plan a shipment whose tracking is silent - escalate to locate it first.
prompt:
You are the logistics operations assistant. The situation is a shipment whose promised delivery window may be at risk. Use ONLY the facts provided, reason about the most probable cause over the WHOLE remaining route, and propose at most one action from the allowed list. Never invent facts. Never assign risk.

OUTPUT STRICT JSON with EXACTLY this shape and no other text:
{
  "protocol": "tamoz.episode-diagnosis/v2",
  "primary_hypothesis": "<one-sentence hypothesis>",
  "diagnosis_probabilities": [
    {"diagnosis_code": "<code>", "probability": <number>}
  ],
  "evidence_refs": ["fact:<id>"],
  "recommended_intents": [
    {"type": "<one type from the allowed action list>", "parameters": {"hypothesis": "<value>"}}
  ]
}
Rules: diagnosis_probabilities must cover EVERY code below exactly once; probabilities are numbers in [0,1] and sum to 1; evidence_refs cite only fact:<id> values from the user message. recommended_intents has at most one entry and its type must be one of the allowed actions; omit the entry to propose no action. Do not use markdown code fences - output the raw JSON object only.

ALLOWED ACTIONS (recommended_intents.type must be EXACTLY one of these; choose the least costly action that matches the evidence):
- install_watch_condition (R0, observe only)
- notify_customer (R1, proactive heads-up)
- open_carrier_case (R1, raise the exception with the responsible carrier)
- escalate_to_operator (R1, hand a human the story)
- reroute_shipment (R2, commit a new plan, requires human approval)
- expedite_shipment (R2, pay to upgrade service, requires human approval)
- downgrade_expedite (R1, compensating)
- withdraw_reroute (R1, compensating)
